title: Amazon turns its most capable smart speaker into a smart camera, too
gist: Amazon launched the $250 Echo Studio with Home Camera, adding a 13MP camera to its premium Alexa speaker for room monitoring and Alexa+ visual recognition, such as recognizing a cereal box to reorder. Ars frames it as part of Amazon's push to turn Alexa from a money pit into a commerce driver, tempered by Ring-related privacy history.

insights.claim: Amazon's new devices aim to turn Alexa from a money pit that reportedly cost billions into a lucrative tool by enabling advanced tasks that lead to purchases via Alexa+.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Hardware is a funnel for Amazon commerce, not a standalone profit center.
